description: Lives the same people would have been expected to survive had they been belted/helmeted, using the within-vehicle (double pair comparison) effectiveness from the matched module applied to all seat positions; the belt estimate is sensitive to survivors' belt use being misrecorded (misreport scenarios)
method: lives = deaths without the device (unbelted passenger-vehicle occupants or unhelmeted motorcyclists killed, FARS 2016-2024) x within-vehicle effectiveness (1 - RR) from the matched module; lives per year divide by the number of years. Seat belts are shown as recorded and under three scenarios in which 5%, 10% or 20% of belted survivors were misrecorded; helmets as recorded. Bounds apply the effectiveness interval to the same death count (the death count itself is observed). Hypothetical, not a causal estimate
inputs: FARS person (INJ_SEV, PER_TYP, AGE, SEX, LOCATION, STR_VEH)
